name: Can standard residential doors be used in a mobile home?

mainEntity.name: Can standard residential doors be used in a mobile home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard residential doors rarely fit directly into mobile homes without custom framing alterations. Manufactured homes typically use non-standard, smaller rough openings and thinner 2x3 wall studs, unlike conventional site-built homes that feature 2x4 or 2x6 construction. If you buy a regular prehung door from a big-box store, the jamb width will be too deep, and the height or width may not fit the framing. A finish contractor like Abraham Becerra at HH Remodeling can either install specialty manufactured home doors or modify the surrounding wall framing, drywall, and trim to accommodate standard interior or exterior residential doors securely.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard doors rarely fit mobile homes directly due to thinner wall studs and non-standard rough openings, requiring framing and jamb modifications to install properly.
